MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.blocked: Automatic retry is paused. Correct the problem, then check / retry this same request. Do not repeat it as a new change.
MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.storageCleanup: The wound result is confirmed, but this browser could not clear its saved request. Reloading may recheck the same result; it will not apply the change twice.
MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.importBlocked: Cannot import over a character with wound history. Create a new character and import the complete JSON there, including its items. Use wound controls to change this character's wounds.
MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.offline: Wound editing needs a connected GM. Pending changes resume automatically when the connection returns.
MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.pending: Saving wound change. Interrupted requests retry automatically when a GM is connected; do not repeat the change.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.retryableWr: The wound change is awaiting confirmation and will retry automatically. You can also check its result now.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.invalidJour: Wound history is incomplete or invalid. Editing is paused to protect the recorded wounds.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.legacyPendi: This pending request came from the old lease prototype. Check the migrated wounds before resolving it; it will not be replayed.
MAELSTROM.wounds.journal.legacyConfirm: This request predates the journal upgrade. After all old browser windows have been closed and the world restarted, inspect the current wounds. Clear this old request without applying it again?
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.invalidRequ: This wound request is invalid. Ask the GM to reconcile the pending change.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.invalidActo: This character is no longer available for wound editing.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.requestIdRe: This wound request conflicts with a recorded request. Ask the GM to reconcile it; do not repeat it.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.pending: A wound change is pending. Check its result before making another change.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.conflict: This wound value changed while you were editing. The latest value is shown; review it before trying again.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.permissionD: You no longer have permission to change this actor's wounds.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.invalidOper: Enter a finite number or leave the wound field blank.
MAELSTROM.wounds.coordinator.invalidStat: The wound values are invalid. Ask the GM to inspect this actor.
